story.overview:
As a platform developer, I want Orion to use Anthropic's Tool Search capability for on-demand tool discovery, so that token usage is reduced when 100+ MCP tools are available and Claude discovers the right tools dynamically.
Key Benefits: - Token savings: 100+ tools at ~200 tokens each = 20k+ tokens saved per request - Latency improvement: Smaller context = faster API calls - Scalability: Can add unlimited MCP tools without context window pressure
Prerequisites: - Beta header `advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20` already in `config.anthropic.allBetas` (Story 6.3) - Model must be Sonnet 4.5+ or Opus 4.5+ (current `claude-sonnet-4-20250514` qualifies)

acceptance-criteria.criterion: - MCP tools from `toolRegistry.getToolsForClaude()` include `defer_loading: true` property - Core tools (memory, code_execution) remain always-loaded (no `defer_loading`) - Static tools registered via `registerStaticTool` remain always-loaded

- New config option `TOOL_SEARCH_ENABLED` (default: `true`) controls feature - When disabled, behavior reverts to current all-tools-in-context mode - Config allows specifying which tools are "core" (always loaded)

- `ToolRegistry.getToolsForClaude()` returns two categories: - Core tools (always in context): memory, code_execution, summarize - Deferred tools (discovered on-demand): all MCP and skill tools - New method `getCoreTool(name)` for quick lookup of always-loaded tools

- When `TOOL_SEARCH_ENABLED=true`, pass only core tools + deferred tool definitions - Claude's `tool_search` tool is automatically available (Anthropic manages this) - Tool execution continues to work for discovered tools via existing `executeTool` handler - No code changes needed for tool execution path - Claude discovers, then calls tools normally

- Langfuse event `tool_search.discovery` logged when Claude uses tool search (per project naming: `{component}.{operation}`) - Langfuse metric `tool_search.tokens_saved` estimates token savings - Log which tools were discovered vs. always loaded per request
- If model doesn't support tool search, fall back to all-tools-in-context - Log warning when fallback occurs - No user-facing errors from tool search configuration
- Unit tests for tool registry changes (core vs deferred categorization) - Integration test verifying tool search discovery flow - Update `project-context.md` with tool search configuration

dependencies.dependency: Story 8.1 - Citations API (both modify src/agent/loop.ts - watch for merge conflicts)

technical-notes.note: These tools should NEVER be deferred: 1. `memory` - Auto-context feature requires immediate availability 2. `code_execution` - PTC container lifecycle requires immediate availability 3. `summarize` - Conversation summarization (Story 7.6) Optionally configurable via `CORE_TOOLS` env var.
Tool Search requires: - `claude-sonnet-4-*` (4.5+) - `claude-opus-4-*` (4.5+) Older models (claude-3-*) do NOT support tool search.

Tool Search Discovery Flow: 1. Request includes core tools (always loaded) + deferred tools (with `defer_loading: true`) 2. Anthropic provides a built-in `tool_search` tool automatically when deferred tools exist 3. Claude calls `tool_search` to discover relevant tools from the deferred pool 4. Anthropic returns matching tool definitions to Claude 5. Claude calls those tools via normal `tool_use` blocks 6. Our `executeTool` handler processes them unchanged - NO code path changes needed
Token Savings Estimation: ```typescript const deferredToolCount = tools.filter(t => t.defer_loading).length; const estimatedTokenSavings = deferredToolCount * 200; // ~200 tokens per tool average ```

Story 8.1 Coordination Notes: - Both stories modify `src/agent/loop.ts` - watch for merge conflicts - Story 8.1 adds `documentCitations` to `AgentLoopResult` - this story should not break that type - Beta header `advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20` is shared (already in `allBetas`)

Modified Files: - `src/config/environment.ts` - Add TOOL_SEARCH_ENABLED, CORE_TOOLS - `src/tools/registry.ts` - Add defer_loading, CORE_TOOL_NAMES, getCoreTool() - `src/tools/mcp/schema-converter.ts` - Add defer_loading to converted tools - `src/agent/loop.ts` - Conditional tool loading based on config - `src/agent/tools.ts` - Update getToolDefinitions() if needed No new files required - enhancement to existing files

Anti-Patterns to Avoid: | Don't | Do Instead | |-------|------------| | Hardcode which tools are core | Use `CORE_TOOLS` config or `CORE_TOOL_NAMES` const | | Apply defer_loading to all tools | Check `defer_loading: true` only for non-core tools | | Fail if tool search not supported | Gracefully fall back to all-tools mode | | Log all tool definitions | Log only counts and categories |

Langfuse events logged for tool_search.discovery, token savings calculated
Unsupported models fall back gracefully with warning log
Unit tests and integration test cover full discovery flow

relevant-sections.section: Story 8.2 adds Tool Search Tool integration to reduce token usage when 100s of MCP tools are available. Beta header `advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20` enables this feature. Model requirements: Sonnet 4.5+ or Opus 4.5+.

All betas in config.anthropic.allBetas: - `context-management-2025-06-27` - Memory tool auto-context - `advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20` - PTC + Tool Search - `code-execution-2025-08-25` - Skills execution + container - `skills-2025-10-02` - Skills API CRUD operations - `files-api-2025-04-14` - File downloads from container Always use `config.anthropic.allBetas` - never construct inline.
Tool naming: snake_case TOOL_NAMES const array - single source of truth toolHandlers: Record<ToolName, ToolHandler> - type-safe registration
While (stop_reason === 'tool_use') loop with: - Container parameter with skills - Container reuse via containerLifecycle - All betas from config.anthropic.allBetas

patterns-to-follow.pattern: Use `config.anthropic.*` from environment.ts, never construct inline
Return ToolResult with success/error, never throw from tools
kebab-case.ts for files, kebab-case.test.ts for tests (co-located)
Use const arrays with `as const`, branded types where appropriate

project-context-rules.rule: Tool errors: Never throw, return `ToolResult<T>` with success/error
Config: Import order matters - `instrumentation.ts` first in `index.ts`
PTC/Skills: Use `config.anthropic.allBetas` array, not individual beta strings
Logging: Include `traceId` in every log entry
